entries.title: A picture you paste waits for a model that can read it
entries.body: When your first mate picks its own model, it now prefers one that reads pictures among models of the same level. If it answers on a model that reads words only, a message with a picture waits with its words and picture, and one card offers to move your first mate to a model that reads pictures, which then answers it. Before, the message ended in Your first mate hit a problem.

picture.alt: A card says your first mate's model cannot read pictures, the message waits, and a button moves it to a model that reads them
